tone.target: warm intimate acoustic-leaning clean with dry room
tone.profile: warm intimate acoustic-leaning clean with dry room
tone.summary: The chain focuses on a warm, intimate acoustic tone using clean preamps (Comp/Boost), minimal drive, and a Fender-style clean amp paired with room reverb to simulate fingerpicked arpeggios.
corrections: favor acoustic feel over amp crunch

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and fingerpicking transients.
Smooth out dynamics and enhance the warmth of arpeggios.
Provide gentle harmonic richness and sustain without heavy grit.
blocks.gap: Using Boost for subtle warmth instead of a dedicated clean boost pedal.

alternatives.reason: If more color is needed, Green OD could provide a slightly vintage touch.

blocks.purpose: Keep the tone clean and avoid heavy drive.
blocks.gap: No dedicated low-gain/clean boost pedal is available in the catalog; keeping this module bypassed.

blocks.purpose: Simulate a Fender-ish clean sound with strong low-mid body.
Provide a focused, articulate clean sound suitable for arpeggios.
Enhance the warm low-mid body and tame any excessive high frequencies.
Add a subtle sense of space and intimacy without sounding artificial.
Minimal delay is preferred; keeping it off to maintain dry intimacy.

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR to enhance room realism and intimacy.

proposals.reason: Enhance the intimate, dry room feel required for Damien Rice's style.
